name: ILLUSTRATIVE: Commercial plan IVF / fertility benefit
summary: Illustrative rules: IVF is covered with a documented infertility diagnosis, prior authorization, age limits, and a waiting period after joining the plan.

program.contact_line: the member services number on your card

eligibility.nationality_note: Plan benefits do not depend on nationality.
eligibility.timeline_note: Coverage must be in force 12 months before the first IVF cycle.

required_documents.label: Infertility diagnosis from a clinician
required_documents.keywords: infertility|diagnosis of infertility|reproductive endocrinolog|unable to conceive
required_documents.why: IVF is covered only with a documented infertility diagnosis.
required_documents.fix: Ask the fertility clinic for a letter stating the infertility diagnosis and how long the member has tried to conceive.

required_documents.label: Prior authorization approval
required_documents.why: Each IVF cycle needs prior authorization.
required_documents.fix: Ask the clinic to submit a prior authorization request to the plan and upload the approval letter.

required_documents.label: Treatment plan with cycle dates
required_documents.why: The plan checks the cycle dates against coverage dates.
required_documents.fix: Upload the clinic's treatment plan showing planned cycle dates.
